content.rendered:
We are eagerly making plans for your child to join us here at Middleton Elementary and have attached the information you will need for the first few days of school.  If you have further questions, please don’t hesitate to call us at 503-825-5300 or drop in to see us Monday – Friday 7:30 – 3:30.  


We welcome you to attend supply night Thursday, August 31st 4:00-6:00.  At this time you can drop of your supplies in the kinder POD A and have a chance to meet all of our wonderful Kindergarten teachers.
